newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha spot prices held steady in quiet trade on Friday.
Traders said some support came from trade house buying interest, but the recent price gains and the resultant wider crack spread as crude continued under pressure kept end-user demand to a minimum.
Physical cargoes were pegged around unchanged at $230 cif.

Swaps initially extended Thursday's $4.50 a tonne losses by a further $3 but the paper market steadied in afternoon trade, clawing back $1-2. Feb stood around $221/$223 a tonne and March around $212/$214.
